why: Bible Atlas links the person Israel (Jacob), but this chapter never uses the name; it speaks of Zion, Jerusalem and Jacob's neighbors (1:17), meaning the people and city, not the patriarch.
In 2:1, 2:3 and 2:5 'Israel' means the nation, not the patriarch Israel (Jacob) whom Bible Atlas links.
The chapter names Daughter Edom (4:21-22), the nation and land, not Esau himself; Bible Atlas links Esau because Edom descends from him.
